THE VALUE FOR YOUR BUSINESS

Keep your CRM. Keep your ERP.
Replace the manual layer in between.

After bind, teams still recreate insurance data in spreadsheets, reports and finance systems. Bordeon brings that work into a structured insurance transaction flow.

01 / CAPTURE ONCE

Stop entering the same risk twice.

Reuse one verified record across policies, endorsements, bordereaux and finance exports.

Less rekeying and fewer mismatched records.
02 / REPORT FROM THE RECORD

Prepare carrier reporting without rebuilding spreadsheets.

Generate each carrier’s required output from structured transaction data instead of assembling it again at reporting time.

Less bordereau preparation and a consistent source for every report.
03 / TRACE EVERY CHANGE

Know what changed. Know what is owed.

Link endorsements, premium adjustments and settlement obligations to the original policy, with its history preserved.

A clear audit trail and traceable amounts due to each carrier.
04 / KEEP YOUR EXISTING SYSTEMS

Connect insurance operations to finance.

Bring bound business into Bordeon and pass structured data downstream. Your CRM owns the relationship; your ERP owns the accounting.

Cleaner handovers without replacing your CRM or ERP.

The insurance record: what was insured, what changed, and what is owed.

FOLLOW ONE CHANGE THROUGH THE BUSINESS

What applies now.
How you got here.

When the vessel’s value changes, the policy is not overwritten. A linked endorsement creates a premium adjustment, feeds the July bordereau and updates the carrier’s settlement obligation.

Current state shows the policy as it applies today. The transaction ledger explains every change. Bordeon records the carrier obligation and exports it to finance; the ERP handles invoices, accounting and payment.

Illustrative marine example. The same transaction model is intended for other specialty lines. Premium and obligation amounts depend on contract terms and are not calculated in this illustrative example.

A PRACTICAL START WITH YOUR EXISTING BOOK

Your spreadsheets are
the starting point.

Bordeon is built for teams who need value before an integration project. Bring an existing book, validate the data and turn familiar files into managed insurance records.

01 / IMPORT

Bring the book you already have.

Upload CSV/XLSX or enter bound business manually. Preserve source references alongside the policy.

02 / VALIDATE

Map fields. Resolve exceptions.

Check risk, coverage, premium and carrier shares before accepting records. Keep mappings aligned with the fields in your book.

03 / REPORT

One record. Each carrier’s format.

Use reusable carrier templates for risk and premium bordereaux, with a finance export for amounts due.

CARRIER-READY OUTPUTS

The bordereau becomes an output — not your database.

Generate risk and premium bordereaux from the same record. Map each carrier’s required columns to reusable templates instead of maintaining separate spreadsheet logic.

AI interprets. Bordeon records.

AI proposes extracted fields for human verification. Premium, commission and obligation calculations remain deterministic and auditable.

A versioned REST API and OpenAPI documentation are central to the architecture. Deeper ERP, placing and PAS connectors follow as the product develops.

BUILT FIRST FOR EUROPEAN SPECIALTY MGAs

For MGAs outgrowing
the spreadsheet handover.

Bordeon is for new, smaller and mid-sized European specialty MGAs and underwriting agencies without a strong post-bind policy system of record. CRM manages clients; Excel or specialist models support underwriting; an ERP runs finance.

Bordeon connects that existing stack for business spanning multiple carriers, binders or facilities. Brokers remain upstream participants; carriers receive reporting; finance teams receive the insurance obligations.

Start with one line of business and one or two carrier relationships: import an existing book, record an endorsement and premium delta, generate the carrier bordereau and export the settlement obligation.

FOR INVESTORS & INDUSTRY PARTNERS

Nordic insurance experience.
A focused infrastructure opportunity.

Bordeon’s founders bring experience from the Nordic insurance industry. That industry perspective grounds the product in the practical handovers between insurance operations, carriers and finance.

A specific first customer.

Specialty MGAs whose post-bind records still live across CRM, spreadsheets, documents and ERP. Bordeon addresses that manual gap.

A measurable first deployment.

One MGA, one line and one or two carriers. Evaluate time per policy, endorsement and bordereau, manual re-entry, exceptions and finance-export preparation.

A path to wider connectivity.

The canonical record and versioned API establish the foundation. Deeper ERP, placing/PAS and carrier connections can follow validated demand.

We welcome financing conversations and collaboration with MGAs, carriers and technology partners to connect specialty insurance operations.
